title: Glowing guitar
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd76e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8892b'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9a8' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb347' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='34' ry='30' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='44' y='12' width='12' height='40' rx='3' fill='#c2703a'/>
  <rect x='46' y='12' width='3' height='40' fill='#e59a5c'/>
  <!-- headstock -->
  <rect x='42' y='6' width='16' height='10' rx='3' fill='#9c5327'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='9' r='1.6' fill='#ffd76e'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='9' r='1.6' fill='#ffd76e'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='13' r='1.6' fill='#ffd76e'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='13' r='1.6' fill='#ffd76e'/>
  <!-- strings -->
  <line x1='47' y1='16' x2='47' y2='76' stroke='#fff3c4' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='16' x2='50' y2='78' stroke='#fff3c4' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='16' x2='53' y2='76' stroke='#fff3c4' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- upper body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='20' ry='17' fill='url(#bodyGlow)'/>
  <!-- lower body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='26' ry='20' fill='url(#bodyGlow)'/>
  <!-- body rim highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='20' ry='17' fill='none' stroke='#ffefb0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='26' ry='20' fill='none' stroke='#ffefb0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- sound hole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='7' fill='#3a1e10'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='7' fill='none' stroke='#ffca5c' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='3' fill='#8a4a22'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='43' y='78' width='14' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#a35224'/>
  <rect x='43' y='78' width='14' height='1.5' rx='1' fill='#e59a5c'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M22 40 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5 z' fill='#fff3c4'/>
  <path d='M78 48 l1.2 3.2 3.2 1.2 -3.2 1.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2 -3.2 -3.2 -1.2 3.2 -1.2 z' fill='#ffe08a'/>
  <path d='M30 86 l1 2.6 2.6 1 -2.6 1 -1 2.6 -1 -2.6 -2.6 -1 2.6 -1 z' fill='#fff3c4'/>
</svg>
